create.name: Yogi Charu
create.bio:
Yogi Charu teaches classical yoga, meditation and Vedic philosophy, and has been doing so for about three decades. Drawn to Bhakti yoga when young, he spent years in Himalayan ashrams living a simple renunciate life and trained in hatha yoga, breathwork, mudras, meditation and the Yoga Sutras. He was initiated into the Saraswati order of monks by Anandakapila Saraswati, an author on Tantra and Kriya yoga, and is also an initiated Brahmin in the Gaudiya Vaishnava line, honouring the late Bhakti Charu Swami as his guru.

His teaching treats yoga as an inner science rather than a fitness practice, with devotion and service at its heart. Most of it now happens online: weekly study of the Srimad Bhagavatam, yoga nidra and meditation sessions, a monthly meditation immersion, and longer trainings in pranayama, yoga nidra and a year-long programme in subtle practices such as dream yoga, inner silence and mantra. He also leads 200- and 300-hour teacher trainings, private sessions and group journeys to sacred sites, most recently a New Year meditation retreat among the temples of Angkor in Cambodia. Short talks from his classes are shared on his YouTube channel.

courses.title: 11-Day New Year Meditation Retreat in Cambodia
courses.description: Eleven days around Siem Reap combining daily meditation, philosophy talks, asana and group practice with visits to Angkor Wat, Ta Prohm, Banteay Srei and other temples.

courses.title: 1-Year Mystic Yoga Training
courses.description: A year of weekly Zoom classes for those who have already done a teacher training, working through inner practices month by month: breath and mantra, inner silence, dream yoga, laya yoga and Vedic numerology. It asks for a short practice every morning and evening.

courses.title: Mental Hygiene Subscription
courses.description: A monthly pass to his regular online sessions: Srimad Bhagavatam study, yoga nidra and the monthly meditation series, all held on Zoom in the evening, US Eastern time.

courses.title: Monthly Meditation Immersion
courses.description: A ninety-minute online class each month open to beginners, each time on a different practice such as chakra focus, awareness of prana or silent mantra repetition.

courses.title: Pranayama Teacher Training
courses.description: Four weekend days on Zoom covering around twenty-five classical breathing practices, from cooling and warming techniques to those used to prepare for meditation, with recordings for anyone who misses a session. New dates are to be announced.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Teacher Training
courses.description: A fifty-hour training over two weekends in leading yoga nidra, the guided practice of conscious relaxation. Dates for the next round are to be confirmed.

courses.title: Private Sessions
courses.description: One-hour sessions with him on meditation, yoga philosophy or hatha yoga practice.

free_resources.title: Yogi Charu on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His guided meditations and talks on the Insight Timer app, free to play.

free_resources.title: 21-Day Meditation Challenge
free_resources.description: Three weeks of guided meditations sent by email, following the first book of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras step by step.

free_resources.title: Guided Yoga Meditations
free_resources.description: A page of his recorded practices, including yoga nidra and meditations on compassion, forgiveness and gratitude.
